async def act(page):
    # Filter orders to show only 'Complete' status
    filter_row = page.get_by_role('row', name='Any . From: Date selector . To : Date selector . . . From: . To : . From: . To : .')
    status_combobox = filter_row.get_by_role('combobox').nth(7)  # Status combobox is the 8th combobox in the filter row
    await status_combobox.select_option('Complete')
    # Click the 'Search' button to apply the filter
    search_button = page.get_by_role('button', name='Search')
    await search_button.click()
    # Wait for the table to update after filtering
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    # Sort orders by 'Purchased On' in ascending order (oldest first)
    header_row = page.get_by_role('row', name='Order # Purchased From (Store) Purchased On Bill to Name Ship to Name G.T. (Base) G.T. (Purchased) Status Action')
    await header_row.get_by_role('link', name='Purchased On').click()
    # Wait for the table to update after sorting
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    # Get the first order row after the header and filter rows (index 2, zero-based)
    first_order_row = page.get_by_role('row').nth(2)
    # Wait for the row to be visible to avoid timeout
    await first_order_row.wait_for(state='visible')
    # Get the billing name from the 'Bill to Name' cell (fifth cell, index 4)
    billing_name_cell = first_order_row.get_by_role('cell').nth(4)
    # Wait for the cell to be visible
    await billing_name_cell.wait_for(state='visible')
    billing_name = await billing_name_cell.text_content()
    # Return the billing name
    return billing_name.strip()
